testsuite.name: com.example.glassproductivity.BackupSafetyTest

testcase.name: restore writes a recovery snapshot of replaced data first
truncated backup is rejected and current items are untouched
snapshot failure aborts restore before any write
zip media restore still writes inside the app files directory
zip media restore refuses paths outside app directories
malformed section rejects whole file with no partial writes
wrong typed section is treated as malformed not absent
